SUMMER_2026_VARIABLE_POINT_FREE_THROW.freeThrowPoints: A single attempt may award 1, 2 or 3 points; standard rules apply in final two minutes of fourth period and overtime.
SUMMER_2026_VARIABLE_POINT_FREE_THROW.transferPolicy: Keep observed PTS, FTM and FTA. Never rewrite PTS as 2*FGM+3PM+FTM or apply an unadjusted NBA free-throw possession proxy to these games. Event-level shot values are needed for equivalence.

otherYears: Full rule versions not yet verified for every tournament. Do not silently inherit current NBA rules.
